subject: Newbie: How to do a subset in contingency tables?

messages.author: 02c5f24555fdc773
messages.subject: Newbie: How to do a subset in contingency tables?
parts:
Hi all,

my apologies for the dumb question, but how would I add a subset in
the contingency tables?

I stratify by Experiment which can have the values C1_1, C1_2, C1_3,
C1_4 and would like to only get the values for one of the experiments
(e.g. C1_1)

So I do Experiment = "C1_1" or Experiment = C1_1 but I always get a
"Invalid Subset. Please enter a logical expression"

and in the console "rror in (function(x, subset) { : unused
argument(s) (Experiment = "C1_1")"

The wiki had no advice on subset.

Any ideas?

Thanks

Markus

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Newbie: How to do a subset in contingency tables?
parts:
= is for assignment, and == is for testing equality. try Experiment == "C1_1"

Some info on constructing subset expressions is available on the wiki:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.Subset

ian

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Newbie: How to do a subset in contingency tables?
parts:
1. go to plots > templates > histogram.
2. drag weight into the 'variable' slot and V1 into the 'color by' slot
